text: The 1980 Gillette Cup was an English limited overs county cricket tournament played between 2 July and 6 September 1980. It was the eighteenth and last edition of the Gillette Cup before it was renamed the NatWest Trophy in 1981. Middlesex won the tournament, defeating Surrey by 7 wickets in the final held at Lord's on 2 September 1980. The competition included the seventeen first-class counties along with five Minor Counties: Cornwall, Devon, Durham, Oxfordshire, and Suffolk. This tournament also marked the first time Ireland participated. Teams that won their first-round matches advanced to the second round; the second-round winners moved on to the quarter-finals; the quarter-final winners progressed to the semi-finals, and the semi-final winners eventually reached the final at Lord's on 2 September 1980.
